# CodexMate 0.0.42
- Fixes menu bar Option-Up/Down and Command-Up/Down handling so modifier-arrow navigation works without AppKit's default menu movement running first. - Keeps Option-Up/Down moving between each project's first thread and Settings, and Command-Up/Down jumping to the first or last menu target. - Adds regression coverage for the menu bar physical modifier mapping while preserving notch menu navigation behavior.
